criteria.requirement: Keep the retryable boundary limited to missing-file reading, with bounded attempts/waits and explicit final error policy. Validate JSON/application fields before one-time startup side effects; do not repeat completed initialization or invent rollback/transactions. Define success, permanent absence, malformed JSON and invalid-field tests using the existing APIs.

Use pinned real APIs and actual consumed materials, cite relevant source symbols and state limits. Native witness facts do not prove an implemented application or answer quality. No library edits or invented APIs.

comparison: Evaluate factual grounding, business behavior and stated constraints; accept equivalent correct answers without keyword, verbosity or reference-answer matching.
